prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical social-media cover image
Primary request: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 image (1080x1350 or closest). Japanese-style kyotei (motorboat racing) scene. late-afternoon race, warm low sunlight, urban riverside course, light ripples.

The boat MUST look like a kyotei racing boat, NOT an offshore powerboat or F1 tunnel boat:
- single-seat racing boat about 3 m long, flat, low and long relative to the racer, light-colored hull (white or pale grey)
- OPEN cockpit with NO canopy, NO roof, NO windshield bubble
- the racer crouches / kneels low inside the open cockpit, leaning forward, both hands on a small steering wheel, plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit (no numbers, no lettering, no logos); face not visible
- one outboard motor on the stern with a big white spray plume behind it
- running straight at full speed seen from a low side angle, spray trailing behind

Composition: boat in the lower half, top 45% dark and uncluttered so a title can be overlaid later.
Lighting/mood: late-afternoon warm low sunlight, cinematic but natural.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates or flags anywhere in the image. No recognizable real person.
Avoid: offshore powerboat, F1 tunnel boat, enclosed cockpit, canopy, roof, windshield bubble, visible face, branding, lettering, numerals, flags.
verification: Visually inspected the generated image. It shows a low, long, light-colored, single-seat open-cockpit kyotei boat running straight at speed from a low side angle, with a crouched helmeted racer, one stern outboard motor, and a large trailing white spray plume. The scene has warm late-afternoon light on an urban riverside course, and the upper 45% is dark and uncluttered. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, or flags were observed.
